entries.name: Marie-Eve Bouchard
entries.project: Hello! So, my project on the English-origin verbs in Quebec French (and maybe other varieties of French)... It took a few months to collect data manually. As I was collecting data on TikTok, a few people mentionned that it would be faster to do so with a computer. How? No idea! Can a computer be trained to collect English-origin verbs (integrated and non-integrated) online? YouTube, video games, TikTok, Instagram, etc. I'm interested in spoken French (with code-swithing to English). It would be amazing to have a bigger corpus. (The one I created has around 1100 utterances.) Is this interesting for the students?
